# Appendix: The Evidence Trio Templates {#sec-evidence-trio}

The three documents every project keeps. Copy them at project start; the discipline is filling them *at the moment of the event*, not after.

## SPEC.md

```markdown
# SPEC — <project name> v<n>

Purpose: <one sentence — what this is for>

Inputs: <every input, with type, range, and format>
Behaviour: <numbered rules; every rule specific enough to test>
Out of scope: <explicitly not doing, this version>

Done means:
- [ ] <runnable check 1>
- [ ] <runnable check 2>
```

## DECISIONS.md

```markdown
# Decisions

| Date | Decision | Why | Revisit when |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-16 | Use plain files, no database | One user, data must be human-editable | More than one user appears |
```

## CRITIQUE.md

```markdown
# Critique

## Position
<what you chose and would choose again>

## Why
<the reason that names a person and a situation>

## What I gave up
<the admitted cost of the choice>

## What would change my mind
<the condition that reverses it>
```
